description: This file defines a singleton class `SettingsWindowOpener` responsible for opening the settings or preferences window in a macOS application. It includes a protocol `SettingsWindowMenuActions` with optional methods to show the settings or preferences windows, and the class manages invocation of these actions, with a fallback to default menu item actions if no custom action is registered.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class that manages opening the settings window in a macOS application.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an action to open the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings window via a custom action or fallback to default menu actions.
